supersedes_nothing: This plan is additive to reports/stage3-experiment-plan-2026-08-12.json, which covers B2 and B3 only and is not modified by it.
dataset_identity: A NEW replication dataset. It is not the historical 432-run raw dataset and must never be described as a recovery of it.
git_tree_clean_scope: all paths except reports/stage3-*.md and reports/stage3-replication-plan-2026-08-13.json; no path under experiments/, scripts/ or tests/ is excluded
seed_policy: Historical seeds, deliberately. The 84 surviving original runs are corroboration only; identical seeds make any discrepancy between them and the replication attributable to the environment rather than to a different workload.

planned_totals.executions_note: executions per run are the regime's, not a plan-level constant; the matrix emits them per run at collection time

corroboration_set.description: Original raw runs that survive in the Research-paper-AEP tree. Read-only. Cross-checked against the replication; never pooled into it, and never counted in any denominator.
